lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 7-8 vertical columns of large, circular, high-luminance pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of moderately elevated pixel intensity intersect with the centroids of the circular blobs, forming a series of grid-like anchor nodes along the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper two-thirds of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high pixel intensity on the dorsal edge to lower intensity/shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A distribution of small, discrete, high-luminance circular blobs is visible across the posterior surface of the first dorsal fin's silhouette in the upper left quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white linear abrasions and intersecting marks are visible on the upper flank, primarily located above the gill slits and extending posteriorly.
other_distinctive_markers: Three elongated, streamlined dark-toned objects are positioned adjacent to the ventral trailing margin of the right pectoral fin.
